test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A is twice as efficient as B. Together, they can complete a task in 12 days. How many days will A alone take to complete the task?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A : B = 2 : 1 (efficiency ratio)

Together efficiency = 3 units

Total work = 12 × 3 = 36 units

A's efficiency = 2 units

⇒ Time taken by A = 36 ÷ 2 = 18 days

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**
